## Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you would like to see added.

## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a specific limitation or problem? Please describe the issue you are encountering.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution or capability you would like implemented.

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative approaches, workarounds, or features you have considered.

## Use Case

Describe your specific workflow (e.g. MCP integration, LSP debugging, performance benchmarking) and how this feature benefits you.

## Implementation Considerations

- **Framing Compatibility**: Does this affect Newline-Delimited or Header-Delimited stream parsing?
- **Stdout Protocol Integrity**: Does this ensure stdout remains 100% clean of non-JSON-RPC text?
- **Platform Scope**: Does this leverage macOS OSLog or cross-platform logging?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, CLI flag proposals, or architecture notes here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have clearly described the motivation and proposed solution
- [ ] I have considered backward compatibility with JSON-RPC stdio clients
